checks.name: accounts_parent_ck
checks.expression: parent_account_id IS NULL OR parent_account_id <> id

cross_row_invariants.name: accounts_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Reject parent cycles and account_type changes that would invalidate descendants.

tables.name: finance.bank_accounts
tables.fact_owner: Bank settlement identity mapped to exactly one ledger account

cross_row_invariants.name: bank_accounts_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Require account_id to reference an active asset account with bank reconciliation enabled.

tables.name: finance.accounting_events
tables.fact_owner: Typed, unique bridge from one posted business source to one journal

checks.name: accounting_events_type_source_ck
checks.expression: (event_type = 'sales_invoice' AND sales_invoice_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type = 'supplier_invoice' AND supplier_invoice_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type = 'adjustment_note' AND adjustment_note_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type = 'supplier_advance_application' AND purchase_order_advance_allocation_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type = 'payment' AND payment_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type = 'expense_claim' AND expense_claim_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type = 'inventory_valuation' AND inventory_document_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type = 'withholding' AND withholding_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: accounting_events_purchase_advance_source_uq
indexes.purpose: apply each supplier advance to accounting exactly once

cross_row_invariants.name: accounting_events_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Reject INSERT unless the typed source and journal are posted, same-tenant, and immutable; block UPDATE and DELETE.

tables.name: finance.journal_entries
tables.fact_owner: Balanced accounting journal header and reversal relationship

checks.name: journal_entries_fx_ck
checks.expression: fx_rate > 0 AND ((transaction_currency = functional_currency AND fx_rate = 1.000000) OR transaction_currency <> functional_currency)

checks.name: journal_entries_posted_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'posted' OR (posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL AND transaction_debit_total > 0)

checks.name: journal_entries_reversal_ck
checks.expression: (reversal_of_journal_entry_id IS NULL AND reversal_reason IS NULL) OR (reversal_of_journal_entry_id IS NOT NULL AND reversal_reason IS NOT NULL)

cross_row_invariants.name: journal_entries_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: On posting require at least two lines, header totals equal line sums in both currencies, every currency bucket balances, and functional amounts equal rounded transaction amounts times fx_rate; lock entry and lines. Reversal posts sign-inverted lines and atomically marks the original reversed.

tables.name: finance.journal_lines
tables.fact_owner: One immutable debit or credit posting line within a journal

checks.name: journal_lines_side_ck
checks.expression: (transaction_debit > 0 AND transaction_credit = 0 AND functional_debit > 0 AND functional_credit = 0) OR (transaction_credit > 0 AND transaction_debit = 0 AND functional_credit > 0 AND functional_debit = 0)

cross_row_invariants.name: journal_lines_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Allow composition changes only while the parent journal is draft; prohibit UPDATE/DELETE after posting.

tables.name: finance.payments
tables.fact_owner: Approved receipt or disbursement aggregate posted exactly once

checks.name: payments_settlement_identity_ck
checks.expression: (payment_method = 'cash' AND bank_account_id IS NULL) OR (payment_method <> 'cash' AND bank_account_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: payments_fx_ck
checks.expression: (currency_code = 'INR' AND fx_rate = 1.000000 AND functional_amount = amount) OR currency_code <> 'INR'

checks.name: payments_approval_ck
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('approved','posted','reversed') OR (approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: payments_rejection_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'rejected' OR (rejected_at IS NOT NULL AND rejected_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL AND rejection_reason IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: payments_posted_ck
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('posted','reversed') OR (posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: payments_reversal_ck
checks.expression: (reversal_of_payment_id IS NULL AND reversal_reason IS NULL) OR (reversal_of_payment_id IS NOT NULL AND reversal_reason IS NOT NULL)

cross_row_invariants.name: payments_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Posting reauthorizes payment.branch_id, locks an active asset settlement_account in the payment currency, and requires every journal line to use the payment branch. A cash payment has no bank_account, while every non-cash payment locks one active bank_account whose account_id exactly equals settlement_account_id. The balanced journal contains exactly one settlement-account line on the directionally correct side for the exact functional amount, then atomically creates exactly one accounting_event and freezes financial fields. A reversal creates a compensating payment, journal, and allocation reversals; it never mutates posted allocations.

tables.name: finance.open_items
tables.fact_owner: Receivable or payable principal created by one accounting event

checks.name: open_items_state_ck
checks.expression: (status = 'open' AND settled_at IS NULL AND reversed_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'settled' AND settled_at IS NOT NULL AND reversed_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'reversed' AND reversed_at IS NOT NULL)

cross_row_invariants.name: open_items_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Derive status from posted allocations under row lock: settled only when unreversed allocation sum equals principal; reject over-allocation and direct financial updates.

tables.name: finance.allocations
tables.fact_owner: Immutable settlement or reversal amount from one payment to one open item

checks.name: allocations_reversal_ck
checks.expression: (reversal_of_allocation_id IS NULL AND reversal_reason IS NULL AND status = 'posted') OR (reversal_of_allocation_id IS NOT NULL AND reversal_reason IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: allocations_state_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'reversed' OR (reversed_at IS NOT NULL AND reversed_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: allocations_withholding_uq
indexes.where: withholding_id IS NOT NULL AND reversal_of_allocation_id IS NULL
indexes.purpose: one original settlement allocation per withholding deduction; the reversal lineage index owns one compensating row

indexes.name: allocations_adjustment_note_uq
indexes.purpose: one original-open-item application per posted adjustment note

cross_row_invariants.name: allocations_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Lock the exact settlement source (posted payment, deducted withholding, or posted adjustment note) and open item; require source/open-item compatibility, same party and currency, and total active allocations not above either source amount or open-item principal. A withholding or adjustment source targets its declared open item and is allocated once. Any adjustment residual becomes a new opposite-side open item owned by the adjustment accounting event. Reversal rows copy and negate settlement effect while original evidence remains immutable.

tables.name: finance.adjustment_notes
tables.fact_owner: Typed sales/purchase debit or credit adjustment header

checks.name: adjustment_notes_side_ck
checks.expression: num_nonnulls(sales_return_id,purchase_return_id)<=1 AND ((side='sales' AND sales_invoice_id IS NOT NULL AND supplier_invoice_id IS NULL AND purchase_return_id IS NULL AND adjusts_open_item_id IS NOT NULL) OR (side='purchase' AND sales_invoice_id IS NULL AND sales_return_id IS NULL AND ((purchase_return_id IS NULL AND supplier_invoice_id IS NOT NULL AND adjusts_open_item_id IS NOT NULL) OR purchase_return_id IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: adjustment_notes_effect_ck
checks.expression: document_effect IN ('increase','decrease') AND ((side='sales' AND direction='credit' AND document_effect='decrease') OR (side='sales' AND direction='debit' AND document_effect='increase') OR (side='purchase' AND direction='debit' AND document_effect='decrease') OR (side='purchase' AND direction='credit' AND document_effect='increase'))

checks.name: adjustment_notes_calculation_policy_ck
checks.expression: rounding_policy IN ('none','nearest_rupee') AND document_discount_kind IN ('none','percent','amount') AND document_discount_basis IN ('taxable_value','price_value') AND ((document_discount_kind='none' AND document_discount_value=0) OR (document_discount_kind='percent' AND document_discount_value BETWEEN 0 AND 100) OR (document_discount_kind='amount' AND document_discount_value>=0 AND document_discount_value=round(document_discount_value,2))) AND btrim(calculation_ruleset_version)<>''

checks.name: adjustment_notes_totals_ck
checks.expression: gross_price_amount >= 0 AND discount_amount >= 0 AND net_value_amount >= 0 AND gst_taxable_value >= 0 AND gst_taxable_value <= net_value_amount AND cgst_amount >= 0 AND sgst_amount >= 0 AND igst_amount >= 0 AND cess_amount >= 0 AND counterparty_payable_amount >= 0

checks.name: adjustment_notes_charge_mechanism_ck
checks.expression: tax_charge_mechanism IN ('normal','reverse_charge') AND ((tax_charge_mechanism = 'normal' AND recipient_assessed_tax_amount = 0 AND counterparty_payable_amount = net_value_amount + cgst_amount + sgst_amount + igst_amount + cess_amount + rounding_adjustment) OR (tax_charge_mechanism = 'reverse_charge' AND recipient_assessed_tax_amount = cgst_amount + sgst_amount + igst_amount + cess_amount AND counterparty_payable_amount = net_value_amount + rounding_adjustment))

checks.name: adjustment_notes_zero_rated_ck
checks.expression: zero_rated_payment_mode IN ('not_applicable','without_payment','with_igst') AND (zero_rated_payment_mode <> 'without_payment' OR (cgst_amount = 0 AND sgst_amount = 0 AND igst_amount = 0 AND cess_amount = 0)) AND (zero_rated_payment_mode <> 'with_igst' OR (cgst_amount = 0 AND sgst_amount = 0 AND igst_amount > 0 AND cess_amount = 0))

checks.name: adjustment_notes_gst_treatment_ck
checks.expression: gst_tax_treatment IN ('statutory','commercial_only') AND ((gst_tax_treatment='commercial_only' AND counterparty_portal_document_line_id IS NULL AND recipient_itc_reversal_evidence_attachment_id IS NULL AND recipient_itc_reversal_confirmed_at IS NULL AND gst_taxable_value=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND igst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0 AND recipient_assessed_tax_amount=0) OR (gst_tax_treatment='statutory' AND ((side='sales' AND ((document_effect='decrease' AND recipient_itc_reversal_evidence_attachment_id IS NOT NULL AND recipient_itc_reversal_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (document_effect='increase' AND recipient_itc_reversal_evidence_attachment_id IS NULL AND recipient_itc_reversal_confirmed_at IS NULL))) OR (side='purchase' AND (document_effect<>'decrease' OR counterparty_portal_document_line_id IS NOT NULL)))))

checks.name: adjustment_notes_posted_ck
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('posted','reversed') OR (approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL AND posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: adjustment_notes_sales_return_uq
indexes.purpose: one compensating adjustment per sales return

indexes.name: adjustment_notes_purchase_return_uq
indexes.purpose: one compensating adjustment per purchase return

cross_row_invariants.name: adjustment_notes_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Posting consumes exactly one typed calculation artifact after comparing the fixed rounding/document-discount policy and every persisted line input/output. It selects and persists the exact active GST adjustment rule for note_date, validates statutory eligibility/deadline and retained evidence, and never permits commercial-only adjustments to reduce GST. Sales statutory decreases require verified recipient ITC-reversal evidence no later than the confirmation timestamp; purchase statutory decreases require an exact verified supplier credit-note portal line. A generic note locks its typed original invoice lines, original tax document and original open item; document_effect records increase/decrease and cumulative decreased quantities, values and GST components cannot exceed the original plus posted increases. Posting creates one signed tax document when statutory, balanced journal, accounting event, and exact allocation/new open-item effects atomically, then locks header and lines. An uninvoiced purchase return has no supplier invoice, tax document, open-item adjustment or allocation and reverses the configured goods-received-not-invoiced liability at the exact locked goods-receipt cost. A return-owned note has exactly one immutable sales_return_id or purchase_return_id, matches that return and its original invoice when invoiced, and is unique for the typed return. For sales reverse charge, recipient-assessed tax is not organization self-assessed; for purchase reverse charge it is. Reversal must be a linked compensating note and cumulative component reversals cannot exceed the original.

tables.name: finance.adjustment_note_lines
tables.fact_owner: Calculation and GST snapshot line owned by an adjustment note

checks.name: adjustment_note_lines_kind_ck
checks.expression: (line_kind = 'product' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND account_id IS NULL AND charge_code IS NULL AND quoted_amount IS NULL AND billed_quantity >= 0 AND free_quantity >= 0 AND billed_quantity+free_quantity>0 AND quoted_unit_rate >= 0 AND uom_code IS NOT NULL AND uom_conversion_factor>0 AND base_billed_quantity=round(billed_quantity*uom_conversion_factor,6) AND base_free_quantity=round(free_quantity*uom_conversion_factor,6) AND free_supply_tax_treatment IN ('excluded_from_taxable_value','included_at_unit_rate')) OR (line_kind='charge' AND account_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IS NULL AND charge_code IN ('freight','packing','insurance','handling','other') AND quoted_amount>=0 AND billed_quantity IS NULL AND free_quantity IS NULL AND uom_conversion_factor IS NULL AND base_billed_quantity IS NULL AND base_free_quantity IS NULL AND free_supply_tax_treatment IS NULL AND quoted_unit_rate IS NULL)

checks.name: adjustment_note_lines_discount_policy_ck
checks.expression: line_discount_kind IN ('none','percent','amount') AND line_discount_basis IN ('taxable_value','price_value') AND (line_kind<>'charge' OR line_discount_kind='none') AND ((line_discount_kind='none' AND line_discount_value=0) OR (line_discount_kind='percent' AND line_discount_value BETWEEN 0 AND 100) OR (line_discount_kind='amount' AND line_discount_value>=0 AND line_discount_value=round(line_discount_value,2))) AND line_discount_amount>=0 AND line_taxable_discount_amount>=0 AND document_discount_amount>=0 AND document_taxable_discount_amount>=0 AND discount_amount=line_discount_amount+document_discount_amount

checks.name: adjustment_note_lines_purchase_treatment_ck
checks.expression: (supplier_invoice_line_id IS NULL AND inventory_cost_treatment IS NULL AND itc_eligibility IS NULL) OR (supplier_invoice_line_id IS NOT NULL AND inventory_cost_treatment IN ('capitalize','expense') AND itc_eligibility IN ('eligible','ineligible','blocked','deferred'))

checks.name: adjustment_note_lines_amount_ck
checks.expression: gross_amount >= 0 AND discount_amount >= 0 AND discount_amount <= gross_amount AND net_value_amount >= 0 AND gst_taxable_value >= 0 AND gst_taxable_value <= net_value_amount AND line_total >= 0

checks.name: adjustment_note_lines_price_taxability_ck
checks.expression: gst_tax_treatment IN ('statutory','commercial_only') AND price_basis IN ('tax_exclusive','tax_inclusive') AND taxability_snapshot IN ('taxable','zero_rated','exempt','nil_rated','non_gst') AND ((gst_tax_treatment='commercial_only' AND gst_taxable_value=0 AND cgst_amount=0 AND sgst_amount=0 AND igst_amount=0 AND cess_amount=0 AND recipient_assessed_tax_amount=0) OR (gst_tax_treatment='statutory' AND ((taxability_snapshot IN ('taxable','zero_rated') AND gst_taxable_value = net_value_amount) OR (taxability_snapshot IN ('exempt','nil_rated','non_gst') AND gst_taxable_value = 0 AND cgst_amount = 0 AND sgst_amount = 0 AND igst_amount = 0 AND cess_amount = 0))))

checks.name: adjustment_note_lines_charge_mechanism_ck
checks.expression: tax_charge_mechanism IN ('normal','reverse_charge') AND ((tax_charge_mechanism = 'normal' AND recipient_assessed_tax_amount = 0 AND line_total = net_value_amount + cgst_amount + sgst_amount + igst_amount + cess_amount) OR (tax_charge_mechanism = 'reverse_charge' AND price_basis = 'tax_exclusive' AND recipient_assessed_tax_amount = cgst_amount + sgst_amount + igst_amount + cess_amount AND line_total = net_value_amount))

checks.name: adjustment_note_lines_tax_ck
checks.expression: cgst_rate >= 0 AND sgst_rate >= 0 AND igst_rate >= 0 AND cess_rate >= 0 AND cgst_amount >= 0 AND sgst_amount >= 0 AND igst_amount >= 0 AND cess_amount >= 0

indexes.name: adjustment_note_lines_sales_source_uq
indexes.purpose: one signed adjustment fact per original sales invoice line and note

indexes.name: adjustment_note_lines_supplier_source_uq
indexes.purpose: one signed adjustment fact per original supplier invoice line and note

cross_row_invariants.name: adjustment_note_lines_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Allow changes only before the parent is posted. Every generic product/charge line has exactly one side-compatible original invoice-line FK and persists billed/free/base quantities, UOM factor, free-supply treatment, price and discount policies, gst_tax_treatment, all calculator outputs, final_residual, tax snapshot, and purchase ITC/cost treatment. The artifact-bound canonical Decimal calculator result must match every field; commercial_only treats quoted prices as gross financial-credit bases and has zero GST adjustment while retaining original HSN/rate lineage. Cumulative signed quantities, financial credits and GST components are locked and checked against original plus increases before header, line and tax facts freeze. Return-owned uninvoiced lines are the only posting path without invoice-line lineage.

tables.name: finance.expense_claims
tables.fact_owner: Employee/member expense claim approval and posting aggregate

checks.name: expense_claims_amount_ck
checks.expression: claimed_amount > 0 AND (approved_amount IS NULL OR (approved_amount >= 0 AND approved_amount <= claimed_amount))

checks.name: expense_claims_approval_ck
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('approved','posted','reversed') OR (approved_amount IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: expense_claims_rejection_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'rejected' OR (rejected_at IS NOT NULL AND rejected_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL AND decision_reason IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: expense_claims_separation_ck
checks.expression: approved_by_membership_id IS NULL OR approved_by_membership_id <> claimant_membership_id

checks.name: expense_claims_posted_ck
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('posted','reversed') OR (posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

cross_row_invariants.name: expense_claims_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Submission and approval recalculate line sums; approval requires a distinct authorized membership. Only approved claims may post, and posting creates exactly one accounting event before locking header/lines.

tables.name: finance.expense_claim_lines
tables.fact_owner: One evidenced expense amount categorized by a ledger account

checks.name: expense_claim_lines_amount_ck
checks.expression: claimed_amount > 0 AND taxable_amount >= 0 AND tax_amount >= 0 AND taxable_amount + tax_amount <= claimed_amount AND (approved_amount IS NULL OR (approved_amount >= 0 AND approved_amount <= claimed_amount))

checks.name: expense_claim_lines_withholding_classification_ck
checks.expression: (withholding_nature_code IS NULL OR btrim(withholding_nature_code)<>'') AND (withholding_contract_reference IS NULL OR btrim(withholding_contract_reference)<>'')

cross_row_invariants.name: expense_claim_lines_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Allow changes only while claim is draft; submission requires evidence under policy and line sums equal header claimed amount; approval freezes approved amounts.

tables.name: finance.bank_statements
tables.fact_owner: Integrity-checked bank statement import and reconciliation state

checks.name: bank_statements_reconciled_ck
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('reconciled','closed') OR (reconciled_at IS NOT NULL AND reconciled_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

cross_row_invariants.name: bank_statements_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Verify opening plus signed line amounts equals closing balance before reconciliation; closed statements and lines are immutable.

tables.name: finance.bank_statement_lines
tables.fact_owner: Immutable normalized transaction line from a bank statement

cross_row_invariants.name: bank_statement_lines_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Insert only during verified import; preserve source order, validate optional running-balance sequence, and block UPDATE/DELETE once imported.

tables.name: finance.reconciliation_matches
tables.fact_owner: Reversible M:N amount match between bank lines and posted journals

checks.name: reconciliation_matches_reversal_ck
checks.expression: (reversal_of_match_id IS NULL AND reversal_reason IS NULL AND status = 'matched') OR (reversal_of_match_id IS NOT NULL AND reversal_reason IS NOT NULL)

cross_row_invariants.name: reconciliation_matches_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Lock both owners; require posted journal in the bank account ledger/currency and prevent active matched sums from exceeding either bank-line amount or journal bank-line amount. Reversal is compensating evidence, never deletion.
